evidence.observation: The checkout request path is checkout-web -> payment-api -> auth-gateway, so auth failures on the payment path can directly block checkout submissions.
Recent change AUTH-2026-0318 was deployed to auth-gateway at 2026-03-22T14:05:00Z and changed issuer and JWKS cache namespace for partner-token validation.
At 2026-03-22T14:05:12Z auth-gateway logged deployment of AUTH-2026-0318 with jwks_namespace=partner-v2 and issuer=partner-v2.
At 2026-03-22T14:08:33Z-14:08:34Z auth-gateway logged a JWKS cache miss on partner-v2, fallback to partner-v1, and validation failure because token_issuer=partner-v2 while allowed_issuers=partner-v1.

payment-api logged token validation failure from auth-gateway with reason=issuer_not_allowed at 2026-03-22T14:08:59Z and then rejected create_payment with auth_result=invalid_issuer at 2026-03-22T14:09:04Z.
checkout-web logged submit_order failed status=401 upstream=payment-api at 2026-03-22T14:09:41Z and then recorded invalid issuer from payment-api at 2026-03-22T14:10:03Z.

At 2026-03-22T14:10:00Z checkout-web 401 rate rose to 18.7%, payment-api 401 rate rose to 21.2%, and auth-gateway 401 rate rose to 28.4% with notes explicitly referencing invalid issuer and issuer mismatch.

excluded_red_herrings.why_not_primary_cause: Metrics mark the issue as isolated to images, and checkout-web later logged that static assets were served normally after retry while checkout remained blocked.
orders-db latency remained normal at p95_query_ms=35 with errors=0, and both payment-api and orders-db logs state the failing checkout request did not reach the database path before the auth gate.
The latency increase is downstream impact from repeated auth failures; checkout-web logs identify payment-api invalid issuer responses rather than an application-local fault.

recommended_next_steps: Roll back AUTH-2026-0318 or immediately restore partner-v2 in auth-gateway allowed_issuers and JWKS cache configuration.
Flush or rebuild the auth-gateway JWKS cache namespace so partner-v2 tokens no longer fall back to partner-v1 data.
Replay a partner-v2 checkout token through auth-gateway and payment-api to confirm validation succeeds without issuer_not_allowed.
Verify checkout-web 401 rate returns to baseline and confirm no residual failures are reaching payment-api.
